body.purpose: Default copy and controls; Inter-forward in skin-modern.css.

label.purpose: Field labels at 600 weight, gray-600 tone.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for controls and switches.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default affirmative action in admin forms and toolbars.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #1e4fd3; border-radius: 0.7rem; padding: 0.6rem 1.4rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1d4ed8; border-color: #1c46bb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); }

components.name: Modern Navbar
components.description: Global shell navigation with deep blue gradient and white links.
components.html: JobRhythmScheduleInventory
components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a8a 0%, #1e40af 100%); color: #ffffff; } .ds-navbar-brand { font-weight: 700; margin-right: 1rem; color: #ffffff; } .ds-nav-link { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link-active, .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }

components.name: Modern Card
components.description: Primary content container for forms, filters, and tables.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f1f3f5; border-radius: 1.25rem; padding: 2rem 2.5rem; box-shadow: 0 12px 35px rgba(0,0,0,0.12), 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border: none; text-align: left; } .ds-card-header { background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); padding-bottom: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #212529; } .ds-card-body { color: #212529; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard Bootstrap-style field used across modules.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 600; color: #4b5563; } .ds-input { width: 100%; max-width: 320px; display: block; padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; font-size: 1rem; color: #212529; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #cbd0d6; border-radius: 0.65rem; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25); }

components.name: Modern Table Wrapper
components.description: Rounded white table container with gray header band.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 0.8rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-table thead th { background: #f3f4f6; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; color: #212529; } .ds-table tbody td { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-top: 1px solid #e5e7eb; color: #212529; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }

narrative.overview: The incumbent JobRhythm admin UI is a Vue 3 + Bootstrap 5 operational console with an active skin-modern.css overlay on top of custom-bootstrap.scss. Users see soft gray backgrounds, rounded cards, Inter-forward typography, a deep-blue gradient navbar, and Tailwind-inspired primary blues.
keyCharacteristics: Data-dense tables, filters, and forms for daily contractor operations
Active visual layer: skin-modern.css with rounded cards and modern navbar
Bootstrap primitives plus AG Grid, vue-select, and module-local SCSS
Legacy chalanpro-theme.scss exists but is not imported in main.js

rules.name: Layered Source Rule
rules.body: Treat skin-modern.css + NavbarComponent classes as the visible incumbent for shell/navigation; do not assume custom-bootstrap.scss alone describes the UI.

rules.name: Status Semantics Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, danger, and info colors must remain unambiguous for operational states.

rules.name: Density Rule
rules.body: Prefer readable operational density; avoid marketing-scale whitespace inside modules.

rules.name: Single Global Layer Rule
rules.body: During upgrade, consolidate to one global style authority; avoid adding a fourth parallel global skin.

dos: Do treat skin-modern.css as the primary visual reference for the current global shell.
Do preserve Bootstrap semantic colors for validation and operational feedback.
Do maintain scannable table/form density and clear filter toolbars.
Do consolidate overlapping global styles during frontend upgrade.
donts: Don't assume custom-bootstrap.scss alone describes what users see.
Don't activate chalanpro-theme.scss without an explicit product decision.
Don't replace operational tables with decorative card layouts without a responsive strategy.
Don't use gradient text, glow shadows, or decorative motion in core workflows.
